author: Pat DesLauriers
text: For first 24 hrs after installing it, your readings  are not correct. Until the picture of blood drop goes away, Libre suggest testing with strips. The sensor needs to be in a fatty part of body and not on side you asleep on. For me my upper thigh reduces false lows and gives me best readings. Hoping the effects of GPL-1 wears off  soon.
